title: My best holiday photo
instructions: Mert en sevdiği tatil fotoğrafını anlatıyor. Yer, zaman ve fotoğraftaki kişilere dikkat et.

script.speaker: mert
script.text: This is my favourite photo. I took it in Cappadocia three years ago.

script.speaker: mert
script.text: We got up at five in the morning to see the hot air balloons.

script.speaker: mert
script.text: It was very cold, so I wore two jumpers!

script.speaker: mert
script.text: In the photo, you can see my wife and my daughter. They are smiling and looking at the sky.

script.speaker: mert
script.text: There were more than a hundred balloons. It was the most beautiful thing I have ever seen.

questions.prompt: When did Mert take the photo?
questions.feedback: Fotoğrafı üç yıl önce (three years ago) çekti. Beş, kalkış saati.
questions.evidence: I took it in Cappadocia three years ago.

questions.prompt: Why did Mert wear two jumpers?
questions.evidence: It was very cold, so I wore two jumpers!
